requirements.detailed_explanation: Configuring zero-trust identity architectures in Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access with MFA risk-based policies, automated device enrollment in Microsoft Intune, and AD Connect hybrid directory sync.
requirements.anti_hallucination_rubric: Must have verified experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Conditional Access, Intune device management, and hybrid AD.

courses: Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300)
remediation.project: Configure a Microsoft Entra ID tenant with Conditional Access, Windows Autopilot device enrollment via Intune, and hybrid AD Connect synchronization.
remediation.action_step: Earn the Microsoft SC-300 (Identity and Access) or MD-102 (Endpoint Administrator) certification.

requirements.title: Fortinet Firewalls, Security Monitoring & Incident Response
requirements.raw_text: Experience managing firewall and network security platforms, preferably Fortinet (FortiGate, EMS, and FortiClient); Experience with security monitoring, log analysis, and incident response across identity, endpoint, and network systems; Experience with scripting or automation (PowerShell or equivalent) strongly preferred; Knowledge and 3+ years’ experience supporting VOIP telecommunications systems and mobile device configuration is required
requirements.detailed_explanation: Configuring Fortinet FortiGate UTM security policies, SSL-VPN with FortiClient EMS, analyzing security logs in SIEM (Microsoft Sentinel), and automating sysadmin tasks in PowerShell.
requirements.anti_hallucination_rubric: Hands-on experience with Fortinet firewalls (FortiGate), security log monitoring, PowerShell scripting, and VOIP telephony.

courses: PowerShell for IT System Administrators (Don Jones)
remediation.project: Deploy a virtual FortiGate firewall in Azure with IPSec VPN, SSL inspection, and PowerShell log export automation.
remediation.action_step: Earn the Fortinet NSE 4 or Microsoft SC-200 (Security Operations Analyst) certification.

requirements.title: Organizational Leadership, Confidentiality & Office 365
requirements.raw_text: The ability to install and upgrade hardware systems, learn new software systems, train others to use the systems and coordinate multiple projects simultaneously is required; Ability to effectively organize and prioritize a wide range of daily tasks with varied deadlines is required; Good judgment required in recognizing and maintaining confidentiality of sensitive information; Strong general computer skills are necessary along with a competent, working knowledge of Windows, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word, Microsoft Outlook, and the Internet; Understanding of Christian ministry and specifically Joni and Friends is desirable
requirements.detailed_explanation: Comprehensive administration of Microsoft 365 productivity suites, coordinating IT rollouts, user training, and managing confidential identity records with high integrity.
requirements.anti_hallucination_rubric: Shows track record of IT project coordination, user training, Microsoft 365 administration, and ethical confidentiality.

remediation.project: Create a comprehensive IT onboarding standard operating procedure (SOP) and automated user provisioning script.
remediation.action_step: Earn Microsoft MS-900 or complete M365 security administration labs.
